notes.title: Patch note v1.5.5
notes.notes:
Community:


Fixed a Workshop submission issue after stuck


Editor:


Added font customization by config for full app
Added navigation by keypad support
Changed the in-app document reader to support key navigation and sidebar index


Player:


Added icon, splash, frame customization

notes.title: Update to v1.5.2 for new walker API and other improvements

Fixed an indexing bug with multiple joysticks


Library:


Added a walker algorithm

Editor:

notes.title: Update to v1.5.1 for library and other improvements

Added a return value for expected duration of a SAY calling

notes.title: Update to v1.5 for new speech synthesizer and other improvements
notes.notes:
Library:


Added a SAY function to synthesize speech


Editor:


Added a PICK_DIRECTORY_DIALOG function to scriptable plugin
Added GET_ASSETS, OPEN_ASSETS functions to scriptable plugin
Fixed a crash bug if frame count was greater than the limitation with scriptable plugin
Fixed a selection bug when frame count was greater than 256
Fixed an asset invalidation issue with cross frame operations with scriptable plugin
Fixed an acquiring issue when copying an entire asset

notes.title: Update to v1.4.9 for new graphics commands and other improvements
notes.notes:
Language:


Fixed a crash bug with number parsing
Fixed a crash bug with invalid expression
Fixed a crash bug with invalid routine invoking
Fixed a memory leak when reassigning an array element with string


Libraries:


Added a `PLOT` function to put individual pixels
Added an `ARC` function to draw arc or pie shapes
Added an `ARCFILL` function to fill arc or pie shapes


Editor:


Added immediate saving on new sprite, map assets created
Changed plot mode of the pencil tool to linked

notes.title: Update to v1.4.8 for new file dialogs and other improvements
notes.notes:
Language:


Fixed a crash bug when using an iterator in a conditional expression
Fixed a crash bug when MOD by zero
Fixed a memory leak with wrong iterator usage
Fixed a wrong scope processing bug when resetting the interpreter


Libraries:


Added file and directory selection dialogs to the GUI library
Fixed a crash bug with invalid database value
Fixed a crash bug with closed archive
Fixed a memory leak with non-closed archive
Fixed an option accessing issue with the network library


Editor:


Fixed a crash bug with pen size greater than 1px

notes.title: Update to v1.4.7 for new font customization and assets navigator
notes.notes:
Language:

Fixed a multiple disposing bug with lambda
Fixed a crash bug with incomplete structures
Fixed a crash bug with unused coroutine


Libraries:

Added a FONT function to customize font face with quantized image for the TEXT function
Added a POLL function to poll network events manually

Fixed a real number formatting bug with different locales
Fixed a potential crash bug with network callback
Fixed a random seeding issue

Added an assets navigation tab, by pressing Ctrl+Tab

Fixed a wrong context menu appearance bug by right mouse click


Player:

Added an option to disable pause on focus lost

notes.title: Update to v1.4.1 for new plugin support

Editor:

notes.title: Update to v1.4 for new functions and improvements
notes.notes:
Visible and sensible changes:


  Add a switch of automatic frame buffer clearing
  Add a CLS function to clear frame buffer manually
  Add a SET_CLEARER function to set the switch of automatic frame buffer clearing
  Fix a termination issue with music


Transparent changes:


  Update many 3rd-party libraries
  Fix a state checking bug with right mouse click
  Fix an accuracy issue with the TOUCH function

notes.title: Update to v1.3.4 for new audio functions and lots of improvements
notes.notes:
Visible and sensible changes:


  Add an option to surf Steam pages using internal browser
  Add a welcome page
  Add an ID type to sound effect
  Add a `WAVE` type to prefab sound effect
  Add functionality to play prefab sound effect with wave object to the `SFX` function
  Add a `STOP` function to stop any audio
  Fix a preview issue with inactive map layers
  Fix a boolean evaluating bug with library object


Transparent changes:


  Add a frame cache to the sprite editor
  Fix a tag setting bug with undo operation in the sprite editor
  Fix an unsaved state issue with new created assets

notes.title: Update to v1.1 to share via Workshop, get new programming libraries, and more other improvements!

    Add tools for Steam Workshop
    Add indicator of unsaved file
    Add non-referenced vector and matrix data types, with operators and functions
    Add a path finding algorithm
    Fix a running issue under offline mode with Steam


Transparent changes:


    Add a dedicated file type for customized data
    Fix a parsing bug with the unary negative operator
    Fix a real number parsing bug with different locales
